ruleDefinitions.name: Potential GobRAT File Discovery Via Grep
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of grep to discover specific files created by the GobRAT malware

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/grep$") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*apached.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*frpc.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*sshd\\\.sh.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*zone\\\.arm.*")))
